Job Details: • Location : 6th Of October - Giza . • Transportation : Provided from the nearest pickup point . • Working Hours : 9:30 PM – 5:00 AM . • Night Shift . • Off Day : Friday . For Apply send your cv on : recruit.eg@speedaf.com
